policies.description: When invoking **create_new_incident_template**, if the request breaches any rule in the ITSM Assistant Policy, the operation must be aborted immediately and the specific policy reason must be returned before any further processing.

policies.description: For **create_new_incident_template**, the assistant must never ask the user for additional clarification. policies.description: If a conflict occurs during the creation of an incident template (e.g., duplicate template name or record locking), the assistant must surface a **409 Conflict** error.
